held.name: Red, white and blue ERA pullover
held.why: Requires RAW re-export: Red channel clipped in about 43% of garment pixels, so the red panels read flat. Re-export from RAW with lower saturation/exposure, or reshoot, before approving colour.

held.name: Multicolor geometric track jacket
held.why: Requires RAW re-export: Red and yellow panels clipped in about 34% of garment pixels. Re-export from RAW before approving colour.

held.name: Brown and cream panel pants
held.why: Requires manual correction: Swing tag still in shot. Automatic removal tried 2026-11-24 and rejected at 100%: tag sits on the cream/brown panel seam beside the crotch fold; no clean same-size brown area to copy from. Needs a manual Photoshop retouch or a reshoot with the tag moved.

held.name: Two-tone denim with DE lettering
held.why: Requires new photography: Only the back (seat seam, yoke, lettered hems) was photographed; no front.

held.name: Cream stacked-logo shorts
held.why: Requires manual correction: Swing tag still in shot. Automatic removal tried 2026-11-24 and rejected at 100%: drawstring cord crosses the tag; refilling around the cord left a ghosted cord. Needs a manual Photoshop retouch or a reshoot with the tag moved.

held.name: Red and navy crest track jacket
held.why: Requires manual correction: Swing tag still in shot. Automatic removal tried 2026-11-24 and rejected at 100%: tag covers the zip; only ~80 px of red below it before the white stripe, so copies repeat or pull in white. Needs a manual Photoshop retouch or a reshoot with the tag moved.

held.name: Taupe Biggest Era tonal tee
held.why: Requires new photography: Right sleeve runs into the frame edge; raised tonal letters read faintly; creases.

held.name: Navy and white striped rugby top
held.why: Requires manual correction: Swing tag covers part of the collar placket; removing it would mean inventing the placket (2026-11-24: automatic removal not attempted). Reshoot with the tag moved, or Photoshop retouch with the garment in hand.

held.name: Ice-blue Dreams 1996 track pants
held.why: Requires manual correction: Swing tag still in shot. Automatic removal tried 2026-11-24 and rejected at 100%: tag spans the blue stripe and the narrow white strip beside the 1996 numerals; copies pull in numeral edges. Needs a manual Photoshop retouch or a reshoot with the tag moved.

held.name: Black flame-logo pants
held.why: Requires manual correction: Swing tag still in shot. Automatic removal tried 2026-11-24 and rejected at 100%: black fabric between the waistband gathers and the lettering is too narrow to copy from. Needs a manual Photoshop retouch or a reshoot with the tag moved.

held.name: Ochre Biggest Era tonal tee
held.why: Requires new photography: Creases and unevenly folded sleeves compete with the raised lettering.

held.name: Teal flame-logo pants
held.why: Requires manual correction: Swing tag still in shot. Automatic removal tried 2026-11-24 and rejected at 100%: tag overlaps the top of the R in ERA (lettering cannot be rebuilt honestly). Needs a manual Photoshop retouch or a reshoot with the tag moved.

held.name: White Oakland City of Dope tee
held.why: Requires new photography: Right sleeve tip reaches the frame edge.

held.name: White North Oakland slogan tee
held.why: Requires product identification or approval: Possible duplicate of WK-M249 (see that product).

held.name: Cream red-triangle graphic tee
held.why: Requires new photography: Numerous diagonal creases distort the front.

held.name: Red DOPEERA wordmark tee, black print
held.why: Requires RAW re-export: Best available front has clipped colour in the export; usable for layout, not for colour sign-off.

held.name: Black and yellow No. 10 soccer jersey
held.why: Jersey colourway follows a national kit; held with the other jerseys until rights are confirmed.

held.name: Red and green No. 7 soccer jersey
held.why: Requires product identification or approval: Red and green No. 7 jersey: the back reads RONALDO 7 and the design follows a national-team kit. Is Dope Era cleared to sell and show it?

held.name: Black Pacific Bell 'Before Google' tee
held.why: Requires product identification or approval: Black 'Before Google' tee: the graphic carries the Pacific Bell name and bell mark. Cleared to sell and show?

held.name: Red DOPEERA wordmark tee, gold print
